主要内容: SAP SE issued a press release on January 29, 2019, announcing its preliminary financial results for the fourth quarter and twelve months ended December 31, 2018. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated by reference. The document includes non-IFRS financial measures, which are not prepared in accordance with IFRS and should be considered in addition to, not as substitutes for, revenue, operating income, cash flows, or other financial performance measures. The press release contains forward-looking statements, which are subject to risks and uncertainties. SAP undertakes no obligation to update or revise these statements. The factors affecting SAP's future financial results are discussed in its filings with the SEC, including its most recent Annual Report on Form 20-F.
